The '''Farbog system''' was a star system located in the [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this system was located in the territory controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
